article.title: 1 [Norms for accreditation of arbitrators.
article.content:
43J1[Norms for accreditation of arbitrators.

Section 43J  ·  Part IA  ·  page 31 of the Act
The qualifications, experience and norms for accreditation of arbitrators shall be such as may be specified by the regulations.]
1 Subs. by Act 3 of 2021, s. 3, for s. 43J (w.e.f. 4-11-2020).
